text:
Fix any AI video in seconds.

Change objects, setting or season.

All with one prompt in Seedance 2.0.

5 examples + prompts below 👇 https://t.co/Qx2aPHKDLw
content: Change the season in the video to winter.

thread_texts:
1) Change the season

Upload the video to Seedance 2.0 and prompt:

"Change the season in the video to winter." https://t.co/wUdKZbO3sb

2) Change the daytime

Prompt:

"Change the daytime in the video to early morning." https://t.co/WjTBBNp1cb

3) Change the object

Prompt:

"Change the bike crossing the street in the video to an ice-cream truck." https://t.co/EV6niFVZtk

4) Change the exterior

Prompt:

"Change the exterior of the house the man is walking into from blue to pink." https://t.co/D3cB6o2TaX

5) Change the interior + meal

Prompt:

"Change the kitchen interior to a gothic-style kitchen.

Keep the same interior across all shots.

Replace the sausage in the pan with a burned grilled cheese sandwich.

In the final shot, the man tastes the sandwich instead of the sausage."

AI animation just became 10x easier 🚀

Unlock the full power of Seedance 2.0.
